patthana21.29:1.1: dhammaṃ paccayā hetu hīno dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana21.29:2.1: na hetuṃ na majjhimaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu majjhimo dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. na na hetuṃ na majjhimaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu majjhimo dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. (gaṇitakena tīṇi.)
patthana21.29:3.1: na hetuṃ na paṇītaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā hetu paṇīto dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na hetuṃ na micchattaniyataṃ
